svg.aria-label: Producer-side channel state today and in the new design
svg.text: Producer-side channel state: where it lives today and where it moves
Each row lists a field, the purpose it serves and what guards it. Boxes are the objects that hold it.
TODAY · three objects, three lock domains
NEW DESIGN · ending state in one UcxOutputQueue, one lock
queues_ (with numArrivingReaders), failedInitializations_ and removedTasks_ each have a mutex
one mutex per task: UcxOutputQueue.mutex_ (destination queues have none)
one per channel · atomics plus dataMutex_
out of scope: removed in a separate change
QueueManager.lock: adds and erases UcxOutputQueue objects only, no decisions

text.tspan: when the Task is gone, or the

svg.text: UcxOutputQueue.lock · one mutex · same object Pending → Active → Removed
DESTINATION STATES (UcxDestinationQueue, no lock of its own)
UCX progress only · bound to its UcxOutputQueue once, at the handshake
out of scope: removed in a separate change
next step: send chunk, end message, or stop
reports: close message, endpoint closed, send failed

g.text: state moves into the UcxOutputQueue, under UcxOutputQueue.lock
field removed; its job passes to events sent to the UcxOutputQueue
Lock order: QueueManager.lock first, then UcxOutputQueue.lock. No Task lock is taken while UcxOutputQueue.lock is held. Reader callbacks and chunk frees run after unlock.
